comparisons.peer_summary: Available-for-sale debt securities are classified in current assets, recorded at fair value with unrealized gains/losses reported in other comprehensive income until realized, and any excess of amortized cost over fair value is assessed for expected credit losses recognized in net income.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose accounting for unhedged/available-for-sale debt securities reported at fair value with unrealized gains/losses in accumulated other comprehensive income. Intel specifies an adjusted cost of $5.2 billion approximating fair value, while AMD explicitly details that any excess of amortized cost over fair value is assessed for expected credit losses recognized in net income, whereas Intel's text does not mention a credit loss assessment mechanism for these specific investments.

sentences.text: Our remaining unhedged marketable debt investments are reported at fair value, with unrealized gains or losses, net of tax, recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
The adjusted cost of our unhedged investments was $5.2 billion as of December 28, 2024 ($4.7 billion as of December 30, 2023), which approximated the fair value for these periods.

Investments in marketable debt securities are available for use in current operations, including those with maturity dates beyond one year, and are classified within current assets on the Consolidated Balance Sheets.

Available-for-sale debt securities are recorded at fair value, with the change in unrealized gains and losses, net of tax, reported as a separate component on the Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income until realized.
Securities with an amortized cost basis in excess of estimated fair value are assessed to determine what amount of the excess, if any, is caused by expected credit losses.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fair Value and Classification of Debt
comparisons.peer_summary: As of November 3, 2024, the estimated aggregate fair value of the company's debt was $65,022 million, with senior notes valued using quoted prices from less active markets and 2023 Term Loans carrying a value approximating fair value due to market observable interest rates. All debt obligations are categorized as Level 2 instruments.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures involve the fair value measurement and classification of financial instruments where carrying value approximates fair value. Intel reports that the adjusted cost of its unhedged investments approximated fair value, while Broadcom reports that the carrying value of its 2023 Term Loans approximates their fair value because they carry a market observable interest rate. Both entities rely on market observable rates or market conditions to justify the approximation of fair value for significant balance sheet items.

sentences.text: The adjusted cost of our unhedged investments was $5.2 billion as of December 28, 2024 ($4.7 billion as of December 30, 2023), which approximated the fair value for these periods.
The carrying value of the 2023 Term Loans approximates their fair value as the 2023 Term Loans are carried at a market observable interest rate that resets periodically.

comparisons.peer_summary: Derivative instruments are measured at fair value and recognized as assets or liabilities. The accounting for changes in fair value depends on the designation: non-designated derivatives recognize gains/losses in other non-operating income/expense; cash flow hedges include gains/losses in accumulated other comprehensive income before reclassification to earnings; and fair value hedges recognize changes in both the derivative and hedged items' fair values in earnings. For foreign currency and commodity cash flow or fair value hedges, time value is excluded from effectiveness assessment and recognized in earnings via amortization.
comparisons.comparison: While Intel discloses the accounting for debt investments (unrealized gains/losses in OCI), Micron discloses the accounting for derivative instruments where gains/losses on cash flow hedges are also included in accumulated other comprehensive income. Both disclosures explain the mechanism by which unrealized gains or losses are temporarily held in equity (OCI) rather than immediately recognized in net income, though the underlying asset classes (debt securities vs. derivatives) differ.

sentences.text: Our remaining unhedged marketable debt investments are reported at fair value, with unrealized gains or losses, net of tax, recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

For derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedges, gains or losses are included as a component of accumulated other comprehensive income and reclassified into earnings in the same line items and in the same periods in which the underlying transactions affect earnings.

comparisons.peer_summary: Marketable securities are classified as available-for-sale, reported at fair value with unrealized gains or losses included in accumulated other comprehensive income, net of tax, with fair value determined based on quoted market prices.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA classify their marketable debt securities as available-for-sale (or report them at fair value with gains/losses in OCI) and determine fair value based on quoted market prices. Intel reports adjusted cost of $5.2 billion approximating fair value, while NVIDIA reports similar treatment for marketable securities comprised of available-for-sale securities, with both explicitly stating that unrealized gains/losses are net of tax and included in accumulated other comprehensive income.

sentences.text: Our remaining unhedged marketable debt investments are reported at fair value, with unrealized gains or losses, net of tax, recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
The adjusted cost of our unhedged investments was $5.2 billion as of December 28, 2024 ($4.7 billion as of December 30, 2023), which approximated the fair value for these periods.

Marketable securities are comprised of available-for-sale securities that are reported at fair value with the related unrealized gains or losses included in accumulated other comprehensive income or loss, a component of shareholders' equity, net of tax.
Fair value of the marketable securities is determined based on quoted market prices.
